statement: For a monomial cover with lattice quotient H/L and reduced irreducible quotient system of degree d, put W=(H/L) wr S_d. If L+span_Z{Σ_(γ∈G_B)d_γ γ:B∈E}≠H, then G<W. If L+span_Z{d_(γ_B)γ_B:B∈E0}=H, then G=W. Here E indexes essential face subtuples, G_B their defining essential normals, d_γ the facial resultant multiplicity, and E0 the tuples whose every face has dimension n−1, hence unique normal γ_B. For analogous support tuples the two tests coincide.
